query: An Enterprise customer paying 18000 USD monthly had 99.3% uptime. What service credit applies?
final_answer:
Service credit calculation for Enterprise customer:
- Monthly fee: 18000 USD
- Uptime achieved: 99.3%
- Uptime SLA: 99.9%
- Service credit: 25% of monthly fee = 4500 USD
This reflects the penalty for falling short of SLA requirements.
